title: Flight controllers at the radio van
description: Two soldiers — flight controllers, Larry says, the same job he held — pose on the steel steps of the big riveted van where Larry did his radio operations. A power cable runs from the van to a field generator; CONEX containers, one with a red cross panel, stand in the background. The street in the background, he thinks, was the 18th Aviation unit's.
researchNotes: Larry's own account (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0011-c18032554.json), confirming the survey's hypothesis that this is his operations van — the exterior of the interior seen in VN-0014/VN-0015. 'Flight controller' as Larry's own word for the job strengthens the aviation-operations picture of the unit. The two men are not yet named — interview goal; their name tapes are magnification targets. 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0011-c18415634.json, -c18415638.json): 'Location: Ton Son Nhut', and 'I think the street in the background is 18th Aviation unit.' His son, who typed it, confirms Larry said 18th and not 118th. It is therefore a unit name distinct from the '118th AOD' he has given as his own (ledger #2), placed as a neighbour, and hedged ('I think'). Not checked.
